description: Shared case table of the Strata kernel's expression language (WG-4957): for each case an expression, an environment and the result crates/kernel/src/expr.rs gives, with its exact error text. source is the expression as the kernel's Display prints it, which crates/substrate/src/syntax.rs parses back, so the kernel's own tests can read the same table: parse source, evaluate or check it in the environment, compare. expr is the same expression as a value of the AST union of tests/fixtures/language/fixtures.js, written as examples write values. An eval environment is the fixture's rule-env (record, old and new a record's fields or null, param, now, principal, has_role the roles held); a check environment is check-env (fields: the shape of each field, params, roles; a field of shape ref is a single reference to an object type that exists). Fields an environment leaves out are empty: no record, no parameters, no roles. There is no lookup, so a reference cannot be followed.
